messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00000: Bravo!\rA promising youth who is about to start\nthe journey of archaeology has\fjust arrived!\r
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00001: What? Just a visitor?\nOh, I see...\fYou got me excited for nothing.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00002: My staff here at the Ruins Research\nCenter is excellent, and the research\fmakes good progress with absolutely\fno effort on my part.\rIf you have any questions, feel free to\ntalk to my staff!
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00003: I managed to unravel quite a lot of the\nmystery of UNOWN with your help!\rThank you, thank you.\nThank you, again!
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00004: The ruins are about 1,500 years old.\nThat’s all we know about them.\rBut it’s not known why they were\nbuilt...or by whom.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00005: Wow, did you catch an UNOWN?\nThat’s wonderful!\rCome to think of it... How come we’ve\nsuddenly started to see UNOWN?
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00006:
You have to hear this!
This is a big discovery!It was you who solved the stone-panel
puzzle that allowed UNOWN to appear.Those tablets are the key to waking
up UNOWN!Still... Why would anyone make such
a key?
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00007:
You have to hear this!
This is a big discovery!If you turn on the radio in the ruins,
you can receive mysterious radio waves!It’s proof that UNOWN communicate
with each other using radio waves!
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00008:
You have to hear this!
This is a big discovery!There are as many UNOWN as there are
letters in the alphabet!There have been 26 types confirmed.
Why don’t you collect them all?
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00009: How do you like the UNOWN Report\nI gave you?\rUNOWN are recorded as you catch them.\nIt is quite useful!
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00010: You have to hear this!\nThis is a big discovery!\rWe have figured out that UNOWN are in a\ncertain order!\fLet me see your report.\r
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00011: There!\nI put the UNOWN in the correct order!\fWe may be able to tell more about them.\r
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00012: What?\nYou found a room with UNOWN symbols?\fThat is a big discovery!\rWe will study them right away.\r
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00013: You have to hear this!\nThis is a big discovery!\rWe have found two new UNOWN symbols!\rIt means that...\nThere must be two more kinds of UNOWN\fsomewhere...\r
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00014:
You have to hear this!
We are learning more and more about the symbols on the floor!...It seems that UNOWN were living at
the ruins with a human clan.It is thought that this clan made the
Pokémon statues underground.The UNOWN were easily scared and
wouldn’t go outside.When more and more people started to
appear around the ruins, the clan that wished to live in harmony with the UNOWN eventually left...Thanks to our research and your
help, we have unraveled so much about their mystery!We have so many things we don’t know
left, of course.Archaeology never ends.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00015: I will let you know if I find out\nanything else.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00016: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} opened the UNOWN Report\nand made notes!
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00017: Thanks to our research and your\nhelp, we have unraveled so much about\ftheir mystery!\rWe have so many things we don’t know\nleft, of course.\rArchaeology never ends.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00018: There are odd patterns drawn on the\nwalls of the ruins.\rThey must be the keys for unraveling\nthe mystery of the ruins.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00019:
The strange Pokémon you saw in
the ruins?They appear to be very much like the
drawings on the walls there.Hmm...That must mean there are many
different kinds of them...
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00020: Huh?\nI seem to be doing nothing?\rCome on!\nI may not look it, but I’m the one who\fdeveloped the UNOWN Report!
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00022: Mystery Pokémon\nName: UNOWN\fA total of 26 kinds found.
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00023: Ruins of Alph Research Report\rI dedicate this report to the\nResearch Center’s founder,\fProfessor Silktree...
messages.msg_0073_D24R0102_00024: There are many academic books.\r“Mysteries of the Ancients”\n“Code-Breaking Guidebook”\f“Weathering Ruins”
